answer: Each name is charged £12 in fees and a 30-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. A seat is earned, not claimed: Seabound dock gate keeper tide licence makes sure of that, since a licence keepers carry after dock audits. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The inlet is on the docket. The clerk notes jetty. The sable is checked, not assumed.
